args.lesson: Worked: one EXEC packaged diagnose.py unchanged (hash equals the tested source), ran the documented command in a clean dir (TASK-179420076111) and recorded the error paths. Result: exit 0, expected_match, close_rc 0, report equal to the saved example except timing. INVALID_CASE, PREPARE_ERROR, ATTACH and VACUUM denials were observed; bad JSON or missing args give a traceback. Portability is Linux-only: hard-coded libsqlite3.so.0, SQLite 3.38+ and Python 3.8+. These are reported, not fixed. Flaw: the aggregate error check had an and/or precedence bug; next time write each check as a separate boolean. Staging only; no downloads, demand or revenue. Exposure, not delivery format, remains the binding constraint.
